query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `funnels` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `description` text,
  `status` enum('draft','active','archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `template_name` varchar(100),
  `accent_color` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#179ca3',
  `bg_color` varchar(20) DEFAULT '#ffffff',
  `logo_url` text,
  `total_views` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `total_conversions` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `total_revenue` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `funnel_pages` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `funnel_id` int NOT NULL,
  `page_type` enum('landing','checkout','upsell','downsell','thank_you','custom') NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `blocks` longtext,
  `next_page_id` int,
  `product_type` enum('course','download','bundle','physical','custom'),
  `product_id` int,
  `custom_price` int,
  `custom_price_label` varchar(100),
  `order_bump_id` int,
  `sort_order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `views` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `conversions` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
